boards.before_jsx:
(
INTRADAY FLOW · FIELD GUIDE · DRAFT
Read the recorded assessment
Expanded guide specimen · existing controls, classifications and evidence model retained
How to read the scan
The rules, options tape and dealer map
1 · Start with the evidence
This board follows a fixed watchlist of institutional leaders: the Mag 7, AI infrastructure and software, semiconductors and equipment, reshoring, defense and power-grid names. Each name has a rule-based classification, seven checks, options activity and reference levels in full evidence.
These labels describe the model’s recorded assessment. Check Sources and each name’s evidence for the available observations and their source times. Availability alone does not confirm that the same conditions hold now; missing or old data remains a limitation.
2 · What each label describes
Buy now — The inputs met the washout, VWAP reclaim and holding-volume rules, with elevated volume or approximate options support. No known quality trap or nearby ceiling excluded the setup; the quality check may still be unknown.
Almost ready — A washout with a trend turn or squeeze is recorded. The reclaim above VWAP is pending, or the off-session assessment is waiting for the open.
In favour — Recorded price is above VWAP, with a trend turn and volume support but no fresh washout.
Take profits — The recorded assessment identifies price extension, or risk near a dealer ceiling or expiry pin. These conditions do not establish that a reversal will follow.
Watch — don’t chase — Recorded price or volume activity lacks a washout setup, or the name carries a known quality-trap flag.
Stand aside — The recorded inputs did not match another setup, or the assessment is waiting for the open. This label alone does not mean the market is quiet.
3 · The options tape (approximate direction)
Call-only net premium supports an approximate estimate of call buying or selling using the tape rule, rather than bid/offer matching. Net premium across calls and puts is a separate total; it cannot establish call direction on its own. Missing observations remain unknown.
The ~soft mark identifies this approximate direction. Unusual-size flags show recorded activity counts. Approximate flow is a supporting input, not confirmation by itself.
4 · The dealer map (reference levels)
The dealer map provides daily/nightly options-chain context: ceilings, floors, expected move and expiry pinning. The chain’s source time is unavailable here. The nightly stop and buy zone, VWAP, session low and dealer levels remain references, not confirmed execution or stop levels. The gamma label provides context and does not establish a live directional signal.
Classifications follow deterministic rules, with no score and no black box. Reference levels and the dealer map supply context, not trade advice.
)

盘中资金 · 阅读指南 · 草案
读懂已有评估
展开阅读指南的示意；沿用现有分类、控件与依据模型。
如何读懂扫描
规则、期权资金带与做市商地图
1 · 先核对依据
本看板跟踪一份固定的机构领涨股名单：Mag 7、AI 基础设施与软件、半导体与设备、回流制造、国防及电网标的。各标的的完整依据包含规则分类、七项检查、期权活动与参考价位。
这些标签说明模型已有的评估。请查看“来源”及各标的的详细依据，核对可用观察与来源时间。数据可用并不代表相关条件当前仍然成立；缺失或较旧的数据仍是限制。
2 · 各标签描述什么
现在买入 — 已有输入满足洗盘、收复 VWAP 与量能持稳规则，并有放量或近似期权资金流支持。已知质量陷阱或邻近天花板未触发排除条件；质量检查仍可能未知。
即将就绪 — 已有形态包括洗盘，以及趋势转强或挤压形态（squeeze）。收复 VWAP 尚待确认，或评估处于非交易时段、等待开盘。
走势占优 — 已有价格位于 VWAP 上方，并有趋势转强与量能支持，但没有新的洗盘结构。
获利了结 — 已有评估识别到价格过度延伸，或邻近做市商天花板／到期钉价区的风险。这些条件并不代表随后必然反转。
观望——勿追 — 已有价格或成交量活动尚无洗盘结构，或该标的带有已知质量陷阱标记。
暂时观望 — 已有输入未匹配其他形态，或评估仍在等待开盘。这一标签本身不代表市场平静。
3 · 期权资金带（方向为近似）
仅看涨期权的净权利金依据资金带规则，近似估计看涨期权的买入或卖出，并非逐笔匹配买卖报价。看涨与看跌期权合计净权利金是另一项总量，不能单独确定看涨期权的买卖方向。缺失观察仍属未知。
~软性 标记表示这种近似方向。异常规模标记展示已有活动计数。近似资金流是辅助输入，不能单独作为确认。
4 · 做市商地图（参考价位）
做市商地图提供每日／夜间期权链背景，包括天花板、地板、预期波动和到期钉价。本页无法提供期权链来源时间。夜间止损与买入区间、VWAP、时段低点及做市商价位均为参考，不能视为已确认的成交或止损价位。Gamma 标签用于解释背景，不代表实时方向信号。
分类遵循确定性规则，无评分、无黑箱。参考价位与做市商地图仅提供背景，不构成交易建议。
)
